title: Supir Truk Pantura
mood: twenty years of road and one phone call
subject: a cement truck driver on the north coast road who stops for his son's phone call
caption: Indonesian tarling from the north coast, in its raw revival form. Melodic electric guitar playing the lead in tarling scales with bent notes and slides, suling bamboo flute answering it, kendang keeping a mid-tempo pattern with gong-like accents on phrase ends, simple bass underneath. Raw and unpolished, recorded like a working band rather than a studio product, guitar-led rather than drum-led. Male voice with heavy north-coast ornamentation and long held notes, worn and unhurried. 104 BPM, D with pelog-leaning intervals. Twenty years of road and one phone call. No koplo double-time, no synth, no trap drums, no glossy pop production, no key change.
lyrics:
[Intro - tarling guitar and suling]

[Verse 1]
Jam dua pagi, jalur pantura, truk muatan semen
Cirebon ke Semarang, sudah dua puluh tahun jalan yang sama
Warung kopi di Indramayu, mbok-nya sudah hafal aku
Kopi hitam, gula sedikit, lima menit, terus jalan

[Chorus]
Supir truk pantura
Jalan ini aku hafal lebih dari muka anakku
Itu bukan bangga, itu cuma kenyataan
Tiap lampu merah aku tahu, tiap lubang aku tahu

[Verse 2]
Anakku telepon, dia bilang dapat juara kelas
Aku berhenti di bahu jalan, aku dengar dia cerita sampai habis
Truk di belakang klakson, aku biarkan
Dua puluh tahun, baru kali ini aku yang bikin macet

[Chorus]
Supir truk pantura
Jalan ini aku hafal lebih dari muka anakku
Itu bukan bangga, itu cuma kenyataan
Tapi suaranya malam ini, aku hafal juga

[Outro - tarling guitar, fading]
Semarang subuh
Bongkar, terus pulang
